entities.summary: Yevgeniy Yuryevich Vladimirov is a chess player and trainer from Kazakhstan. He was awarded the title of Grandmaster by FIDE in 1989. Evgeny Vladimirov was a journalists & chroniclers from Almaty (b. 1957-01-20, Almaty). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
